chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn 'Ali al-Mithami al-Kufi, from some of his companions, from 'Amr ibn Shimr, from Jabir, from Abi Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:

Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام gave judgment concerning a slave who killed a free man by mistake; then, after he had killed him, his master set him free. He said: So he validated his emancipation and made him liable for the blood-money.

key_terms.الدِّيَةَ: blood-money compensation due for the killing

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a slave accidentally kills a free person and is then freed by his master?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal ruling from Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام regarding a slave who accidentally killed a free man and was then emancipated by his master. The ruling affirms the validity of the emancipation while also establishing liability for the diyah, reflecting principles of justice and financial responsibility.
